name: 李明哲
objective:
1.Using ADFT 16nm FinFET and/or CIC18 with EDA tools
2.Introduction to Deep Neural Networks
3.Design of Hardware for Processing DNNs
4.ADC Designs
schedule:
week  1      Introduction to Deep Neural Networks
week  2-4    Overview of Deep Neural Networks
week  5-6    Key Metrics and Design Objectives
week  7-8    Kernel Computation
week  9      Mid-term exam or Mid-term project
week  10-12  Designing DNN Accelerators
week  13     Integrating Converters
week  14     Flash Converters
week  15-17  Successive-Approximation Converters
week  18     Final exam or Final project 
Note 1: The above weekly schedules are subject to change without further notice.
Note 2: Laboratory sessions will be provided to strengthen practical hands-on skills.
scorePolicy:
Attendance: 20%
Homework: 20%
Mid-term exam or Mid-term project: 30%
Final exam or Final project: 30%
materials:
(1) Vivienne Sze, Yu-Hsin Chen, Tien-Ju Yang, and Joel S. Emer, "Efficient Processing of Deep Neural Networks," Springer
(2) David A. Johns and Ken Martin, "Analog Integrated Circuit Design," Wiley
consultation: (1) 辦公室: 綜科 311-1 室 (2) Office Hours: 如系統公告 (3) Email: minglee@ntut.edu.tw
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: (1) 本課程將以英文授課，內容將包含神經網路與 ADC 相關積體電路設計知識，歡迎有興趣的同學多加選修。(2) 電路設計與模擬相關軟體受智慧財產權相關法律所保護，請修課同學們務必遵守保密協定，切勿對軟體之任何相關畫面進行截圖、照相或錄影，亦不可將相關技術文件內所含之內容外洩，以觸法。(3) 因教室設備關係，本課程將使用 Microsoft Teams 作為教學輔助平台 (不會使用北科 i 學園 Plus)
